name: desktop
description: ASM Platform — Electron desktop shell (Demo-ready hibrit)

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @asm/web build && pnpm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false WIN_CSC_LINK=  electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm --filter @asm/web build && pnpm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false WIN_CSC_LINK=  electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
